segments.he:
תּוֹרָה פה
הָעֶצֶם לוּז שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּעֹרֶף הָאָדָם שֶׁיִּשָּׁאֵר אַחַר כִּלְיוֹן הַגּוּף, וּמִמֶּנּוּ יִתְחַדֵּשׁ בִּנְיַן הַגּוּף בִּשְׁעַת תְּחִיַּת הַמֵּתִים, זֶהוּ עִקַּר נֶחָמָתֵנוּ (עַיֵּן פְּנִים):
segments.en: When there is smallness and a blemish in faith — one must do difficult labours — such as fasting and the like. But when faith is complete — one can serve Hashem Yisborach in everything. For the Holy One, blessed be He, does not deal tyrannically with His creatures.
